atAGlance: Chè ba màu is the classic three-color dessert cup: beans, pandan jelly, coconut milk, and crushed ice layered so every spoonful changes texture.
whatItIs: Chè ba màu means three-color chè, usually a layered cup of beans, jellies, coconut milk, and ice.
howToEnjoy: Dig down through the layers before stirring everything together. The contrast between creamy, chewy, icy, and soft is the point.
howLocalsOrder: Order chè ba màu by cup, then decide ice and coconut milk. Stir only after admiring the red bean, mung bean, jelly, and coconut layers.
worthKnowing: Chè is Vietnam’s broad dessert-drink world, and ba màu is one of the easiest first cups to understand visually because the layers show texture before you taste it.
goodToKnow: This is as much about texture as sweetness. Stir lightly if you want the coconut milk to reach every layer.
